title: compete despite disadvantage
context: A rival offers a physical contest while Kei is recovering.
observed_actions: Accepts a contest and ultimately wins, but cannot continue indefinitely.
observed_result: Demonstrates resolve at substantial physical cost.
epistemic_limits: Do not infer invulnerability or a numeric combat ceiling.
